This is a pedestrian gravel/paver courtyard with no visible curb cuts, driveway pavement, or vehicles anywhere in the photo set — the whole yard reads as pedestrian-only, so a "drive path" distance can't be established and is treated as none observed.

The harness run from the meter anchor to this footprint measured about 0.5 ft (same pier), well under the 16 ft threshold, with no doors, driveways, or gaps to cross. No gas equipment, HVAC, pool, or fencing is visible near the spot, and the main entrance stairway/door swing (right side of Photo 8) is tens of feet away and unobstructed. No vehicle-accessible pavement, driveway, or parked cars are visible in any supplied photo of this courtyard, so drive-path distance is not applicable/observed. All criteria for a pass are met with a clearly visible, unobstructed spot."}
